A Croaking Cryptid#116.dst: 不过看大伙儿见到我的反应，我大概算是个怪胎吧。
A Croaking Cryptid#116.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#117.src: I'm a frog, I guess? Except I'm much bigger and talk human.
A Croaking Cryptid#117.dst: 我是青蛙吧，大概？只不过个头大得多，还会说人话。
A Croaking Cryptid#117.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#118.src: And to be honest with ya? I have no idea why I'm different to the others. I mean, I dunno if you've noticed, but dey ain't exactly fluent in human. Nor do dey wear clothes.
A Croaking Cryptid#118.dst: 跟你说实话？我也不知道我为啥跟别的青蛙不一样。我是说，不知道你注意到没，他们人话说得可不咋地。也不穿衣服。
A Croaking Cryptid#118.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#119.src: Fun question! I have no crrrroakin' clue.
A Croaking Cryptid#119.dst: 这问题有意思！我一点——呱——头绪都没有。
A Croaking Cryptid#119.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#120.src: I don' remember much from my early life... Hardly even my childhood. Real long time ago, see.
A Croaking Cryptid#120.dst: 早年的事我记不得多少……连小时候都没啥印象。那可是老早以前了。
A Croaking Cryptid#120.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#121.src: I was raised by this... er... weird person. Father? Mother? Couldn' really tell. Dey seemed real proud to be my parent, though.
A Croaking Cryptid#121.dst: 把我养大的是个……呃……怪人。是爹？是妈？我也说不上来。不过那人好像真的很自豪能当我的家长。
A Croaking Cryptid#121.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#122.src: Some other folks around 'em did not seem so pleased, I remember. Maybe dey put me here 'cuz 'ey didn' want me...
A Croaking Cryptid#122.dst: 我记得，那人身边有些家伙可没那么高兴。也许他们就是不想要我，才把我丢到这儿来的……
A Croaking Cryptid#122.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#123.src: Uh, yeah, we all have one, don' we? Y'know? The first person ya see when ya emerge from the tar pits?
A Croaking Cryptid#123.dst: 呃，对啊，人人都有一个，不是吗？你知道的吧？就是你从焦油坑爬出来时见到的第一个人？
A Croaking Cryptid#123.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#125.src: Not much, really. I s'pose I just sit around like a lazy crrrroakin' loser and wait for the frogs to tell me a human is in the bog.
A Croaking Cryptid#125.dst: 也没啥。大概就是像个——呱——懒鬼废物一样干坐着，等青蛙们告诉我沼泽里来了人类。
A Croaking Cryptid#125.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#126.src: When that happens, I gotta go outside and scare 'em off. Or well, that's usually how it goes, anyway.
A Croaking Cryptid#126.dst: 人一来，我就得出去把他们吓跑。起码，一般都是这么个流程。
A Croaking Cryptid#126.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#127.src: Ah, well, dey're the ones who make me do this, I guess.
A Croaking Cryptid#127.dst: 啊，这个嘛，我这活儿大概就是他们派的。
A Croaking Cryptid#127.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#128.src: Every couple weeks, see, some weird person with a funny mask shows up with my payment.
A Croaking Cryptid#128.dst: 你看，每隔几周，就有个戴着滑稽面具的怪人带着我的工钱过来。
A Croaking Cryptid#128.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#129.src: Dey ask me details about the people I scared off. But er, don' worry, I won't tell 'em 'bout you.
A Croaking Cryptid#129.dst: 他们会问我吓跑的那些人的详细情况。不过呃，别担心，我不会把你说出去的。
A Croaking Cryptid#129.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#130.src: T'be honest, I don't know why dey have me doin' all that. But I don' really care, s'long as I get my fair share.
A Croaking Cryptid#130.dst: 说实话，我也不知道他们为啥要我干这些。不过我也不咋在乎，只要我那份该得的不少就行。
A Croaking Cryptid#130.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#131.src: What? Pal, I literally SAID it. How could there be any confusion???
A Croaking Cryptid#131.dst: 啥？伙计，我刚才明明说了。这还能有啥搞不清的？？？
A Croaking Cryptid#131.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#132.src: It's like "Joaquin" but CROAK. Croaquin. Understand?
A Croaking Cryptid#132.dst: 就是“Joaquin”，不过开头换成 CROAK，呱的那个。Croaquin。懂了吗？
A Croaking Cryptid#132.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#133.src: ...Stop lookin' at me like that. I wasn't the one who came up with it, alright?
A Croaking Cryptid#133.dst: ……别那样看着我。这名字又不是我起的，行吧？
A Croaking Cryptid#133.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#145.src: Tell me more about this fella. Why'd you think I'd have any connection to 'im?
A Croaking Cryptid#145.dst: 跟我多说说这家伙。你为啥觉得我跟他有关系？
A Croaking Cryptid#145.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#146.src: ...Toad with a top hat... in a rainbow forest... speakin' cryptic nonsense?
A Croaking Cryptid#146.dst: ……戴礼帽的蟾蜍……在彩虹森林里……满嘴神神叨叨的胡话？
A Croaking Cryptid#146.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#148.src: Good to see ya again, pal. Got anythin' to say?
A Croaking Cryptid#148.dst: 又见面了，挺好，伙计。有啥要说的？
A Croaking Cryptid#148.speaker: Croaquin

A Wynnic Excavation#001.src: 'Ey, boss, ya sure this is where we need t'blow things up? There's equipment an' all here. This place been empty for a while now too.
A Wynnic Excavation#001.dst: 嘿，老大，你确定是要在这儿炸吗？这儿还堆着设备啥的呢。这地方也空了好一阵子了。
A Wynnic Excavation#001.speaker: Miner

A Wynnic Excavation#002.src: The small spec I found might not've been much, but it could mean that there are more emeralds nearby. That's why I brought our friend here to confirm.
A Wynnic Excavation#002.dst: 我找到的那点小碎屑也许不算啥，但这说明附近可能还有更多绿宝石。所以我才请这位朋友来确认一下。
A Wynnic Excavation#002.speaker: Miner Chief

A Wynnic Excavation#003.src: Hm. Do you hear that? The sound indicates a large body of crystals just right behind these rocks.
A Wynnic Excavation#003.dst: 嗯。听到了吗？从声音判断，这些岩石正后方有一大片水晶。
A Wynnic Excavation#003.speaker: Geologist

A Wynnic Excavation#006.src: Let's see 'ere... Red, purple, green n' yellow. Say, boss, ain't these them crystal that lad not too long ago asked ya 'bout?
A Wynnic Excavation#006.dst: 让咱瞧瞧……红的、紫的、绿的、黄的。我说老大，这不就是前不久那小子跟你打听的那种水晶吗？
A Wynnic Excavation#006.speaker: Miner

A Wynnic Excavation#007.src: These are not just some 'crystals'. They're... Dangerous. All of you, listen up - never speak a word of what you saw here.
A Wynnic Excavation#007.dst: 这些可不只是什么“水晶”。它们……很危险。你们都给我听好了——今天在这儿看到的，一个字都不许说出去。
A Wynnic Excavation#007.speaker: Miner Chief

A Wynnic Excavation#008.src: Both of you, back to your posts, now! I'll make sure these are never seen again.
A Wynnic Excavation#008.dst: 你们俩，马上回自己岗位去！我会确保这些东西再也不见天日。
A Wynnic Excavation#008.speaker: Miner Chief

A Wynnic Excavation#009.src: Inspecting the strange crystal sparks a memory.
A Wynnic Excavation#009.dst: 端详这块奇异的水晶时，一段记忆涌上心头。

Aldwell Library#002.src: No medallion! What are you then, a changeling?
Aldwell Library#002.dst: 没有徽章！那你到底是什么东西，易形者吗？
Aldwell Library#002.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#003.src: Can't say I've ever heard of a '{u}' before.
Aldwell Library#003.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#004.src: Come back when you've got some proof of who you are, '{u}'.
Aldwell Library#004.dst: 等你有办法证明自己的身份了再回来吧，“{u}”。
Aldwell Library#004.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#006.src: I thought I told you, you can't fool me!
Aldwell Library#006.dst: 我不是跟你说过了吗，你骗不了我！
Aldwell Library#006.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#007.src: Oh, you just want to know what's behind this door?
Aldwell Library#007.dst: 哦，你只是想知道这扇门后面有什么？
Aldwell Library#007.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#008.src: Fine. No harm in that, I suppose.
Aldwell Library#008.dst: 行吧。我想告诉你也无妨。
Aldwell Library#008.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#009.src: I'm in charge of guarding the new {p} Library!
Aldwell Library#009.dst: 我负责看守新建的 {p} 图书馆！
Aldwell Library#009.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#010.src: It's a collection of every ancient text found around Mistwood that's been put to paper.
Aldwell Library#010.dst: 这里收藏着 Mistwood 一带发现的、已誊抄成册的所有古代文献。
Aldwell Library#010.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#011.dst: 而且我说古代，那就是真的古老。
Aldwell Library#011.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#012.src: You won't get past me, {u}. I know what you really are!
Aldwell Library#012.dst: 你休想过我这关，{u}。我知道你的真面目！
Aldwell Library#012.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#013.src: If you really want me to believe your story, I suppose there's something you could do for me...
Aldwell Library#013.dst: 如果你真想让我相信你的说辞，我想你倒是可以帮我做件事……
Aldwell Library#013.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#014.src: Would you like to hear it?
Aldwell Library#014.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#018.src: Around {p}, there are four trees that have served as essential parts of our area's history.
Aldwell Library#018.dst: {p} 一带有四棵树，它们在这片地区的历史中一直举足轻重。
Aldwell Library#018.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#019.src: Flowers grow at their bases too, and they're used in everything from decorating our homes to making helpful remedies.
Aldwell Library#019.dst: 它们的树根旁也开着花，这些花用途很广，从装饰家居到调制良药都少不了。
Aldwell Library#019.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#020.src: My personal supply is running low right now, so I'm in need of a new bouquet...
Aldwell Library#020.dst: 我手头的存货快用完了，所以需要一束新的花……
Aldwell Library#020.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#021.src: My task for you is to go and bring me one of each flower!
Aldwell Library#021.dst: 你的任务就是去把每种花都给我带一朵回来！
Aldwell Library#021.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#022.src: The first flower can be found under the white tree of altruism, straight east of here.
Aldwell Library#022.dst: 第一朵花在白色的利他之树下，从这里{c2}一直往东{/}走就到。
Aldwell Library#022.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#023.src: The second flower blooms inside the tree of community, which is growing all around us!
Aldwell Library#023.dst: 第二朵花开在社群之树里面，这棵树就长在{c2}我们四周{/}！
Aldwell Library#023.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#024.src: The third flower grows by the carcass of the tree of renewal, which lies to the south of this library.
Aldwell Library#024.dst: 第三朵花长在再生之树的残骸旁，残骸就躺在{c2}这座图书馆南边{/}。
Aldwell Library#024.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#025.src: The final flower can be found at the base of the tree of resistance, which the Canopy call their home.
Aldwell Library#025.dst: 最后一朵花在抵抗之树的树根旁，那里是{c2}树冠会的家园{/}。
Aldwell Library#025.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#026.src: Come back to me with all four of them, and perhaps we could work something out from there.
Aldwell Library#026.dst: 把四朵花都带回来，到时候我们或许可以谈谈。
Aldwell Library#026.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#027.src: Have you got me what I asked for yet?
Aldwell Library#027.dst: 我要的东西你弄到了吗？
Aldwell Library#027.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#028.src: No? Well, come back when you do.
Aldwell Library#028.dst: 没有？那就等弄到了再来。
Aldwell Library#028.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#029.src: If you need a reminder, the first flower can be found under the white tree of altruism, straight east of here.
Aldwell Library#029.dst: 提醒你一下，第一朵花在白色的利他之树下，从这里{c2}一直往东{/}走就到。
Aldwell Library#029.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#030.src: The second flower blooms inside the tree of community, which grows all around us!
Aldwell Library#030.dst: 第二朵花开在社群之树里面，这棵树就长在{c2}我们四周{/}！
Aldwell Library#030.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#031.src: The third flower grows in the carcass of the tree of renewal, which lies to the south of this library.
Aldwell Library#031.dst: 第三朵花长在再生之树的残骸里，残骸就躺在{c2}这座图书馆南边{/}。
Aldwell Library#031.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#033.src: I hope that you find them all for the next time we speak.
Aldwell Library#033.dst: 希望下次说话时，你已经把它们都找齐了。
Aldwell Library#033.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#035.src: I'm sure I'll find a use for them soon.
Aldwell Library#035.dst: 我相信很快就能用上它们。
Aldwell Library#035.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#036.src: In the meantime, enjoy access to the {p} Library!
Aldwell Library#036.dst: 在此之前，尽情使用 {p} 图书馆吧！
Aldwell Library#036.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#038.src: I don't care what you are any more, just go through to the library...
Aldwell Library#038.dst: 我不管你是什么东西了，赶紧进图书馆吧……
Aldwell Library#038.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#040.src: It seems to be a book about the different clans in the region, though a little dated- it says it was written in {~} NA. Still, could be fun to flick through.
Aldwell Library#040.dst: 这似乎是一本介绍本地区各氏族的书，只是有点过时了——上面写着成书于 {~} NA。不过翻翻看应该还挺有意思。

Aldwell Library#041.src: ...That's the end of that passage. Read another?

Aldwell Library#042.src: The Canopy is a merger of three independent clans, the Owls, Foxes, and Deers, who were among the oldest clans in the forest, and had a longstanding rivalry.
Aldwell Library#042.dst: {c1}树冠会由三个独立氏族合并而成，即猫头鹰族、狐狸族和鹿族。它们是森林中最古老的氏族之一，彼此长期竞争。{/}

Aldwell Library#043.src: Prior to the Cutoff, the Owls were led by Sovereign Caetal, who ruled over the entire {p}, though the Foxes and Deers also vied for the position.
Aldwell Library#043.dst: {c1}大封锁之前，猫头鹰族的首领是 Caetal 统领，他治理着整个 {p}，不过狐狸族和鹿族也一直在争夺这个位置。{/}

Aldwell Library#044.src: Each of the three clans had its own strength. The Foxes were adept combatants. The Deers, strategic geniuses. And the owls, stealth.
Aldwell Library#044.dst: {c1}三个氏族各有所长。狐狸族骁勇善战。鹿族是战略天才。而猫头鹰族则擅长潜行。{/}

Aldwell Library#045.src: ...Despite this, Caetal was a man of the people. His blessing of voice helped him rally the community together. The three clans became close, and what had once been a bitter rivalry became a friendly one.
Aldwell Library#045.dst: {c1}……尽管如此，Caetal 仍是一位亲民的领袖。声音的祝福让他得以凝聚社群。三个氏族日渐亲近，昔日的激烈竞争也化作了友好的较量。{/}

Aldwell Library#047.src: After the discovery of the first Changeling, and its subsequent execution, Caetal was removed from his post, and the {p}, cut off from the outside world. Caetal would then disappear.
Aldwell Library#047.dst: {c1}第一个易形者被发现并处决后，Caetal 被撤职，{p} 也与外界隔绝。此后，Caetal 便销声匿迹了。{/}

Aldwell Library#048.src: The three clans were mortified to have lost the man who brought them so close together, and combined into one group, The Canopy.
Aldwell Library#048.dst: {c1}失去了这位让他们如此亲密的人，三个氏族悲痛万分，于是合而为一，组成了树冠会。{/}

Aldwell Library#049.src: The Canopy has, ever since, been a proactive enemy of the Queen, and their masks have become symbols of resistance against the Changeling threat.
Aldwell Library#049.dst: {c1}从那时起，树冠会便一直积极与女王为敌，他们的面具也成了抵抗易形者威胁的象征。{/}

Aldwell Library#050.src: The Kalkalrah Clan is a clan that lives in the further reaches of the {p}, composed of mercenaries-for-hire. They keep no alliances, as they only help whoever pays them.
Aldwell Library#050.dst: {c1}Kalkalrah 氏族生活在 {p} 的偏远地带，由受雇的佣兵组成。他们不与任何势力结盟，只为出钱的人效力。{/}

Aldwell Library#051.src: When paid, however, they make up for it well, being some of the most skilled fighters in the region. Generally, they are hired for the task of helping guard.
Aldwell Library#051.dst: {c1}不过一旦拿了钱，他们绝对物有所值，堪称这一带身手最好的战士。他们通常受雇协助守卫工作。{/}

Aldwell Library#052.src: The only exception they make is that they refuse to assist in anti-crown activities, as they wish not to become a target for the Queen's military.
Aldwell Library#052.dst: {c1}他们唯一的例外是拒绝参与反王室活动，因为他们不想成为女王军队的目标。{/}

Aldwell Library#053.src: The Peacekeeper's Clan are a group that lives in {p} directly, comprised of those who wish to keep the town a neutral and safe hub for all clans to come together, and a quiet place for citizens to live.
Aldwell Library#053.dst: {c1}治安氏族是直接住在 {p} 镇内的团体，成员都希望这座城镇保持中立安全，成为各氏族汇聚之地，也让居民能安静度日。{/}

Aldwell Library#054.src: Members are usually local volunteers who align with the clan's overarching goal, and want to lend a hand. It has a democratic structure, with leaders chosen by the clan itself.
Aldwell Library#054.dst: {c1}成员通常是认同氏族宗旨、愿意出力的本地志愿者。氏族采用民主制度，首领由氏族自己选举产生。{/}

Aldwell Library#055.src: The Peacekeepers maintain a doctrine of neutrality with other clans, as they do not want to be seen as an enemy to any other clan in the woods. This has earned them high favour with practically everyone.
Aldwell Library#055.dst: {c1}治安队对其他氏族奉行中立原则，因为他们不想被森林里的任何氏族视为敌人。这也让他们几乎赢得了所有人的好感。{/}

Aldwell Library#056.src: The Lostheth Clan are a clan of beast-tamers, residing in the outskirts of {p}.
Aldwell Library#056.dst: {c1}Lostheth 氏族是一个驯兽氏族，居住在 {p} 的郊外。{/}

Aldwell Library#057.src: Up until recent times, the Lostheth clan were a very obscure group, and they were on the verge of disbandment due to lack of interest.
Aldwell Library#057.dst: {c1}直到不久之前，Lostheth 氏族还是个默默无闻的团体，因无人问津而濒临解散。{/}

Aldwell Library#058.src: However, with the appearance of Adasaurs around the {p}, this all changed. The Lostheth Clan, masters of beast-taming, were quickly able to bring the creatures under their control.
Aldwell Library#058.dst: {c1}然而，随着 Adasaur 出现在 {p} 一带，一切都改变了。身为驯兽大师的 Lostheth 氏族很快就驯服了这些生物。{/}

Aldwell Library#059.src: In doing so, they pioneered the practice of riding on their backs. This quickly became a subject of interest to other clans, as well as many citizens, and the Lostheth clan went from being nobodies to one of the best-known clans in the woods.
Aldwell Library#059.dst: {c1}他们也由此开创了骑乘 Adasaur 的先河。这很快引起了其他氏族和许多居民的兴趣，Lostheth 氏族也从无名之辈一跃成为森林里最负盛名的氏族之一。{/}

Aldwell Library#060.src: This book is called "The Four Virtuous Trees"
Aldwell Library#060.dst: 这本书名叫{c2}《四棵美德之树》{/}。

Aldwell Library#061.src: It's some kind of guide both to survival and morals. Give it a read?
Aldwell Library#061.dst: 这似乎是一本兼谈求生与道德的指南。读一读吗？

Aldwell Library#062.src: This book is called "The World Outside The Woods".
Aldwell Library#062.dst: 这本书名叫{c2}《森林之外的世界》{/}。

Aldwell Library#063.src: It seems to be a book from {~} KA, talking about other regions. Would you like to read it?
Aldwell Library#063.dst: 这似乎是一本 {~} KA 的书，讲的是其他地区。要读吗？

Aldwell Library#064.src: ...That's the end of the introduction. Read another part of the book?
Aldwell Library#064.dst: ……序言到此结束。再读读这本书的其他部分？

Aldwell Library#065.src: There are also various illustrations and maps of the {p}, but it looks almost identical to the {p} of today. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#065.dst: 书中还有 {p} 的各种插图和地图，不过看起来和如今的 {p} 几乎一模一样。继续读吗？

Aldwell Library#066.src: Next to this description, there is a collection of illustrations of the region. It's completely unrecognizable to you. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#066.dst: 这段描述旁边附着一组该地区的插图。你完全认不出这是哪里。继续读吗？

Aldwell Library#067.src: Accompanying the text are sketches of these "great mines," but, as stated by the text, it looked pretty much the same as the regions around it. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#067.dst: 文字旁配有这些“大矿区”的素描，不过正如书中所说，那里看起来和周边地区没什么两样。继续读吗？

Aldwell Library#068.src: There are drawings of the {p} alongside the text. It looks pretty much the same as you saw it on the way to the tournament, though there may be slight differences. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#068.dst: 文字旁有 {p} 的插画。看起来和你前往锦标赛途中所见大致相同，不过可能略有差异。继续读吗？

Aldwell Library#069.src: With the text, there are pictures of Aelumia. Though you didn't get to see too much of the city during the tournament, it looks somewhat different to what you remember. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#069.dst: 文字旁附有 Aelumia 的图片。你在锦标赛期间没怎么看过这座城市，但它和你记忆中的样子似乎有些不同。继续读吗？

Aldwell Library#070.src: It has been {~} years since our freedom to leave these woods was taken from us, and already, many of our youngest are wondering what the lands beyond are like.
Aldwell Library#070.dst: {c1}我们离开这片森林的自由被剥夺已有 {~} 年，而许多年轻人已经开始好奇，外面的土地究竟是什么模样。{/}

Aldwell Library#071.src: We elders have been a capable source of information on this matter, but the world is changing. We are dying out. And so, I have decided to write down what I know, so it may be passed down for future generations to learn from.
Aldwell Library#071.dst: {c1}一直以来，我们这些长者都是这方面可靠的信息来源，但世界正在改变，我们也日渐凋零。因此，我决定把所知的一切写下来，传给后世，供他们学习。{/}

Aldwell Library#072.src: In the northwest lies the {p}, a vast woodland filled with trees whose leaves take on a warmer colour than the green leaves found on the few deciduous trees in the {p}.
Aldwell Library#072.dst: {c1}西北方是 {p}，一片广袤的林地，这里的树叶色泽温暖，不同于 {p} 中少数落叶树的绿叶。{/}

Aldwell Library#073.src: A river runs through the region, though its water is limited by a colossal dam in the east.
Aldwell Library#073.dst: {c1}有一条河流经此地，但东边的一座巨型水坝限制了它的水量。{/}

Aldwell Library#074.src: Tradition has it that, once upon a time, the forest's leaves were green, much like ours, but the reduced flow of water has caused them to lose colour and die, giving them their redder hues.
Aldwell Library#074.dst: {c1}相传，这片森林的树叶曾经和我们这里的一样翠绿，但水流减少让它们失去颜色、逐渐枯死，这才染上了偏红的色调。{/}

Aldwell Library#075.src: There are also legends of a tree bigger than any of ours, from before the Cursed Age. Its stump remains now, the only proof of its existence.
Aldwell Library#075.dst: {c1}传说在受诅时代之前，这里还有一棵比我们所有树都要高大的巨树。如今只剩下它的树桩，是它存在过的唯一证据。{/}

Aldwell Library#076.src: The {p} is home to many such traditions, as its people are the most spiritual of any region. The ruins of an ancient temple sit in the northern reaches of the area, holding much value to its god-fearing folk.
Aldwell Library#076.dst: {c1}{p} 有许多这样的传统，因为这里的人们是所有地区中最虔诚的。古代神殿的遗迹坐落在这片地区的北端，对敬畏神明的当地人来说意义重大。{/}

Aldwell Library#077.src: This temple is likewise believed to predate the Cursed Age, though its purpose is unknown, so the citizens ascribe various traditions to it. The Crown condemns many of these traditions as heretic in nature, though they persist regardless.
Aldwell Library#077.dst: {c1}这座神殿据信同样早于受诅时代，但用途不明，居民们便赋予了它各种传统。王室斥责其中许多传统为异端，但它们依然流传至今。{/}

Aldwell Library#078.src: The biggest town in the {p} is {p}, which sits on the boundary with the Agricultural District and is where most traded goods from said region arrive. A large fox statue sits in the town square, serving as a distinct local landmark.
Aldwell Library#078.dst: {c1}{p} 最大的城镇是 {p}，它位于与农业区的交界处，该地区的交易货物大多运到这里。镇广场上有一座巨大的狐狸雕像，是当地独特的地标。{/}

Aldwell Library#079.src: Just to the west of the {p}, still visible from the highest trees at the border, is the Agricultural District.
Aldwell Library#079.dst: {c1}就在 {p} 的西边，从边界最高的树上依然望得见的地方，便是农业区。{/}

Aldwell Library#080.src: This name was given to it by the Crown to distinguish it as a region dedicated to agriculture on the behalf of the rest of the province, though some within refer to it by the less stiff, older name "Tolas."
Aldwell Library#080.dst: {c1}这个名字是王室取的，以表明这里是专门为行省其他地区从事农业的区域，不过当地有些人仍称呼它那个不那么呆板的旧名“Tolas”。{/}

Aldwell Library#081.src: As previously stated, this region is a designated farm zone, where all citizens labour to produce food for the other regions.
Aldwell Library#081.dst: {c1}如前所述，这里是指定的农业区，所有居民都要劳作，为其他地区生产粮食。{/}

Aldwell Library#082.src: Since we were severed from the rest of Fruma, we have stopped receiving the fruits of this labour, though sometimes anti-government clans manage to steal such products from the many Crown supply wagons that pass through the area.
Aldwell Library#082.dst: {c1}自从我们与 Fruma 其他地区断绝往来，就再也收不到这份劳动成果了，不过反政府氏族偶尔能从途经此地的众多王室补给车队中偷到这些物资。{/}

Aldwell Library#083.src: Tolas' many farms are built upon a beautiful, open, sprawling plain, where wildlife such as deer live in relative harmony with humans.
Aldwell Library#083.dst: {c1}Tolas 的众多农场建在一片美丽开阔、绵延辽远的平原上，鹿等野生动物在这里与人类相对和谐地共处。{/}

Aldwell Library#084.src: Although the people there make open their growing dissatisfaction with Sovereign Amastli's traditionalist policy, they generally live happy lives.
Aldwell Library#084.dst: {c1}尽管当地人公开表达对 Amastli 统领守旧政策日益增长的不满，但他们大体上过得很幸福。{/}

Aldwell Library#085.src: To the south are the Great Mines. As the name would suggest, this section of the province has long been devoted to quarrying for resources. and, like the Agricultural District, is home to a full populace of workers.
Aldwell Library#085.dst: {c1}南边是大矿区。顾名思义，行省的这一部分长期致力于开采资源，并且和农业区一样，居民全是工人。{/}

Aldwell Library#086.src: The actual surface geography of the Great Mines is mostly indistinct from its neighbours.
Aldwell Library#086.dst: {c1}大矿区地表的实际地貌与周边地区几乎没有区别。{/}

Aldwell Library#087.src: What differentiates the region from others is the number of valuable natural resources under the ground. As such, a wall has been built to indicate the divide between there and here.
Aldwell Library#087.dst: {c1}这片地区与众不同之处在于地下蕴藏着大量珍贵的自然资源。因此，人们筑起一道墙，标明那边与这边的分界。{/}

Aldwell Library#088.src: Most of the area's citizens live in the central mining hub, Deraj, rather than any smaller settlements as seen in other regions. Since the end of the Cursed Age, they have been endlessly, passionately mining for Fruma.
Aldwell Library#088.dst: {c1}这里的大部分居民都住在中心矿业枢纽 Deraj，而不是像其他地区那样分散在小聚落中。自受诅时代结束以来，他们一直不知疲倦、满怀热情地为 Fruma 采矿。{/}

Aldwell Library#089.src: At the beginning of the Knowledge Age, when Sovereign Oru ascended, these mining operations intensified, in search of Cinnabar. Some parts of the Great Mines have since become quite worn down.
Aldwell Library#089.dst: {c1}知识时代之初，Oru 统领即位，为寻找朱砂，这些采矿作业愈发紧锣密鼓。此后，大矿区的部分区域已相当破败。{/}

Aldwell Library#090.src: North of the {p} are the {p}, the most affluent region of Fruma. This region is a hilly moor home to all kinds of gorgeous flowers and other such plants, including trees with fruits that flower pink.
Aldwell Library#090.dst: {c1}{p} 以北是 {p}，Fruma 最富庶的地区。这里是丘陵荒原，生长着各种绚丽的花草，还有开粉色花的果树。{/}

Aldwell Library#091.src: The area is embroiled in a constant soft power struggle among various influential families, though one particular family - called the Nasins - have quite consistently maintained supremacy. Their patriarch, Gitephe, is the region's Sovereign.
Aldwell Library#091.dst: {c1}这里的各大豪门之间一直明争暗斗，不过其中一个名为 Nasin 的家族长期保持着霸主地位。其族长 Gitephe 正是该地区的统领。{/}

Aldwell Library#092.src: Within this region is the gate to {p}, and so, a large amount of the province's trade must pass through it.
Aldwell Library#092.dst: {c1}通往 {p} 的大门就在这片地区之内，因此行省的大量贸易都必须经过这里。{/}

Aldwell Library#093.src: This is problematic for the Crown, as the {p} are the only way up into the {p}, and our clans frequently attempt to rob supply wagons.
Aldwell Library#093.dst: {c1}这对王室来说是个麻烦，因为 {p} 是上行前往 {p} 的唯一通路，而我们的氏族经常试图抢劫补给车队。{/}

Aldwell Library#094.src: Though it neighbours the {p}, they are separated from one another by a sheer difference in height, where the {p} stands.
Aldwell Library#094.dst: {c1}虽然它与 {p} 相邻，但两地之间隔着悬殊的高度差，{p} 就矗立在那里。{/}

Aldwell Library#095.src: The presence of this dam has led to what once was a river becoming a large lake, at the edge of which the region's capital city, {p}, is situated.
Aldwell Library#095.dst: {c1}这座水坝的存在使昔日的河流变成了一座大湖，该地区的首府 {p} 就位于湖畔。{/}

Aldwell Library#096.src: This region is also home to a great variety of fascinating creatures, though, contrary to popular folkloric belief, there aren't any winged snakes.
Aldwell Library#096.dst: {c1}这里还栖息着种类繁多的奇妙生物，不过和民间传说不同，这里并没有长翅膀的蛇。{/}

Aldwell Library#097.src: In the very heart of Fruma is {p}, the capital city of the province, and home of the Queen. It rests atop a plateau overlooking the surrounding regions, so its looming wall is not a sight unique to our woods.
Aldwell Library#097.dst: {c1}Fruma 的正中心是 {p}，它既是行省首府，也是女王的居所。城市坐落在俯瞰四周的高原上，所以并非只有我们的森林才看得到它高耸的城墙。{/}

Aldwell Library#098.src: Being in the city is a very unique experience. It is completely unlike the quiet life we live in the woods. There is almost no nature around at all, only buildings; not an inch of land has not been used for construction.
Aldwell Library#098.dst: {c1}身处城中是一种非常独特的体验，与我们在森林里的宁静生活截然不同。周围几乎没有自然，只有建筑；每一寸土地都被用来盖房子了。{/}

Aldwell Library#099.src: Among the many noteworthy places in the citadel are the military's headquarters, the Royal University, and the Queen's palace.
Aldwell Library#099.dst: {c1}城塞内值得一提的地方有很多，包括军队总部、皇家大学和女王的宫殿。{/}

Aldwell Library#100.src: Those few fortunate enough to see the inside of the palace described it as the height of luxury, exceeding even their wildest imagination. It's a shame that none from these woods may ever see such beauty again.
Aldwell Library#100.dst: {c1}极少数有幸见过宫殿内部的人形容那里奢华至极，超乎他们最大胆的想象。可惜这片森林里的人再也无缘见到这样的美景了。{/}

Aldwell Library#101.src: According to legends passed down from our forefathers, the plateau was once the best place in the world for viewing the night sky, as the view was almost completely without obstructions.
Aldwell Library#101.dst: {c1}根据祖辈流传下来的传说，这座高原曾是世上观赏夜空的最佳地点，视野几乎毫无遮挡。{/}

Aldwell Library#102.src: Today, this is no longer true, as the famous city wall obscures most of this view. However, the University is said to have a place for viewing the stars that sees above this border.
Aldwell Library#102.dst: {c1}如今已非如此，著名的城墙遮住了大部分景色。不过，据说大学里有一处观星点，能越过这道边界看到星空。{/}

Aldwell Library#103.src: ...It seems to be some sort of children's story book. Would you like to read it?
Aldwell Library#103.dst: ……这似乎是一本儿童故事书。要读吗？

Aldwell Library#104.src: This book is called "Sight of Sasha".

Aldwell Library#105.src: Once upon a time, in the land of Uthak, there lived a little boy named Nannah, or so his people called him.
Aldwell Library#105.dst: {c1}从前，在 Uthak 这片土地上，住着一个叫 Nannah 的小男孩，至少族人都这么叫他。{/}

Aldwell Library#106.src: Nannah was a troublesome, mischievous boy, who always disobeyed his elders, and lied to get out of trouble.
Aldwell Library#106.dst: {c1}Nannah 是个顽皮捣蛋的孩子，总是不听长辈的话，闯了祸就撒谎开脱。{/}

Aldwell Library#107.src: One day, his mother took him out foraging in the woods. The woods were a dangerous place, and Nannah had to stay close for his own safety. But he did not want to do that.
Aldwell Library#107.dst: {c1}一天，妈妈带他到森林里采集食物。森林是个危险的地方，为了安全，Nannah 必须紧跟着妈妈。可他并不想这样。{/}

Aldwell Library#108.src: When his dear mother was busy picking berries, Nannah ran out into the woods, seeking his own adventure, though he did not travel very far, because shortly after he departed, he was stopped by a voice.
Aldwell Library#108.dst: {c1}趁亲爱的妈妈忙着摘浆果，Nannah 跑进森林，想去找属于自己的冒险。可他没走多远，因为刚出发不久，就被一个声音叫住了。{/}

Aldwell Library#109.src: "Nannah, you must stop," said the voice, "It is not good to misbehave."
Aldwell Library#109.dst: {c1}“Nannah，你必须停下，”那声音说，“不守规矩可不好。”{/}

Aldwell Library#110.src: Nannah turned to the source of the voice, up in the trees. Two big, blue eyes stared back, and the eyes belonged to an owl with beautiful white feathers. "Who are you?" asked Nannah.
Aldwell Library#110.dst: {c1}Nannah 转向声音传来的地方，望向树上。两只蓝色的大眼睛正回望着他，眼睛的主人是一只羽毛洁白美丽的猫头鹰。“你是谁？”Nannah 问。{/}

Aldwell Library#111.src: "I am Sasha," said the owl, "The judge of Uthak. You must listen to your elders, Nannah, they know best."
Aldwell Library#111.dst: {c1}“我是 Sasha，”猫头鹰说，“Uthak 的审判者。你必须听长辈的话，Nannah，他们最清楚。”{/}

Aldwell Library#112.src: Nannah responded, "Why, Sasha? I have traveled far from my mother, yet I am fine. She was wrong; these woods are safe."
Aldwell Library#112.dst: {c1}“为什么，Sasha？”Nannah 回答，“我走了这么远，离妈妈好远，可我一点事都没有。她说错了，这片森林很安全。”{/}

Aldwell Library#113.src: "Because, Nannah, monsters like me eat naughty children like you. I have been watching your behaviour for a long time, with my eyes that pierce the mists. You must stop being such a disrespectul boy, or else you may become my dinner."
Aldwell Library#113.dst: {c1}“因为啊，Nannah，像我这样的怪物，专吃你这样的坏孩子。我用这双能穿透迷雾的眼睛，已经观察你的所作所为很久了。你不能再这样目无尊长，否则，你就可能成为我的晚餐。”{/}

Aldwell Library#114.src: Nannah was frightened by this, and ran back to where his mother was. He found her there, calling his name. "Nannah? Nannah!!!" she yelled.
Aldwell Library#114.dst: {c1}Nannah 吓坏了，赶紧跑回妈妈身边。他看到妈妈正在那里呼喊他的名字。“Nannah？Nannah！！！”她喊道。{/}

Aldwell Library#115.src: When Nannah approached her, she was very disappointed in him. "You cannot go running off into the forests, Nannah," she said, "It is not safe!"
Aldwell Library#115.dst: {c1}Nannah 走到她跟前时，她对他非常失望。“你不能往森林里乱跑，Nannah，”她说，“那里不安全！”{/}

Aldwell Library#116.src: Nannah promised her that he would never venture into the forest alone again. "Are you sure, Nannah?" she said, "A promise is something you ought not break."
Aldwell Library#116.dst: {c1}Nannah 向她保证，再也不会独自进森林了。“你确定吗，Nannah？”她说，“承诺可是不能打破的。”{/}

Aldwell Library#117.src: He agreed, and they went home. But, that night, Nannah could not sleep, for an idea kept circling his mind.
Aldwell Library#117.dst: {c1}他答应了，两人便回了家。可是那天夜里，Nannah 怎么也睡不着，因为有个念头一直在他脑海里打转。{/}

Aldwell Library#118.src: "Stupid Sasha," he thought, "Nobody should tell me what I can and cannot do!"
Aldwell Library#118.dst: {c1}“笨蛋 Sasha，”他想，“谁也别想告诉我能做什么、不能做什么！”{/}

Aldwell Library#119.src: Nannah, not wanting to be bossed around by the owl, made his decision. He got up from his bed, and tip-toed out of his house. He would break his promise he made to his mother, and ignore Sasha's recommendation.
Aldwell Library#119.dst: {c1}Nannah 不愿受一只猫头鹰摆布，便下定了决心。他从床上爬起来，踮着脚溜出了家门。他要打破对妈妈的承诺，也不理会 Sasha 的忠告。{/}

Aldwell Library#120.src: The forest was dark at night, and barely anything could be seen. The only things Nannah could make out were the Candleferns that dotted the forests.
Aldwell Library#120.dst: {c1}夜晚的森林一片漆黑，几乎什么都看不见。Nannah 唯一能辨认的，只有点缀在林间的 Candlefern。{/}

Aldwell Library#121.src: Despite the danger of getting lost, Nannah could not bring himself to admit defeat and head home. He walked from Candlefern to Candlefern, for several minutes, until the quiet sounds of the village were gone. It was silent.
Aldwell Library#121.dst: {c1}尽管有迷路的危险，Nannah 还是不肯认输回家。他从一株 Candlefern 走到另一株 Candlefern，走了好几分钟，直到村子里轻微的声响都消失了。四周一片死寂。{/}

Aldwell Library#122.src: "Hello again," said a familiar voice, "I see you have not learned."
Aldwell Library#122.dst: {c1}“又见面了，”一个熟悉的声音说，“看来你还是没学乖。”{/}

Aldwell Library#123.src: "Sasha???" yelped Nannah, "How did you get here? I didn't hear you!"
Aldwell Library#123.dst: {c1}“Sasha？？？”Nannah 尖叫道，“你怎么来的？我都没听见你的声音！”{/}

Aldwell Library#124.src: "I am one with the winds, Nannah, my flight is as silent as the mist itself. Nobody can ever hear my approach. It makes me very good at catching naughty children to have for my dinner."
Aldwell Library#124.dst: {c1}“我与风同在，Nannah，我飞起来如同雾气本身一般无声。没有人听得见我靠近。所以我很擅长抓住顽皮的孩子，当作我的晚餐。”{/}

Aldwell Library#125.src: Before he knew it, Nannah had been lifted off his feet, and was brought through the darkness to Sasha's wicker nest, never to be seen again.
Aldwell Library#125.dst: {c1}转眼间，Nannah 便被提离了地面，穿过黑暗，被带到 Sasha 的柳条巢中，从此再也没有人见过他。{/}

Aldwell Library#126.src: The mist of our forest home is dense and widespread; many get lost trying to find their way through the fog. As such, our people have devised various methods to remember the area better.
Aldwell Library#126.dst: {c1}我们森林家园的雾气浓重而弥漫，许多人想穿过迷雾时都迷了路。因此，我们的族人想出了各种方法来更好地记住这片地区。{/}

Aldwell Library#127.src: One popular method is learning the Virtuous Trees, a group of distinct trees throughout the woods that embody a set of precepts.
Aldwell Library#127.dst: {c1}一种流行的方法是学习美德之树。这是散布在森林各处的一组独特树木，每棵都体现着一条戒律。{/}

Aldwell Library#128.src: Knowing each of these trees means that they can be used as a reference point if you are lost. They also provide great teachings to live by.
Aldwell Library#128.dst: {c1}认识这些树，迷路时就能把它们当作参照点。它们也提供了宝贵的人生教诲。{/}

Aldwell Library#129.src: First is the Tree of Community, the single tree specimen that {p} is built around. Indeed, the trees of {p} are in fact one single specimen, grown from one tree in what is called a "clonal colony."
Aldwell Library#129.dst: {c1}第一棵是社群之树，{p} 正是围绕这棵树建起来的。事实上，{p} 的树木其实是同一个个体，由一棵树长成，即所谓的“克隆群落”。{/}

Aldwell Library#130.src: This tree represents the importance of community and family; that, despite our differences, and our aggressions, we are all one, and must ultimately cooperate to build each other up.
Aldwell Library#130.dst: {c1}这棵树象征着社群与家庭的重要性。无论我们有多少分歧与争执，我们都是一体的，终究要携手合作、彼此成就。{/}

Aldwell Library#131.src: Second is the Tree of Altruism, a distinctly different Redwood thanks to its small size and white leaves.
Aldwell Library#131.dst: {c1}第二棵是利他之树，这棵红杉因身形矮小、叶色洁白而格外不同。{/}

Aldwell Library#132.src: This tree is in fact an Albino Redwood, and it is believed that its frail appearance is the result of an assistance it provides to its fellow trees.
Aldwell Library#132.dst: {c1}这棵树其实是一棵白化红杉，人们相信它羸弱的外表是因为它一直在帮助周围的同伴。{/}

Aldwell Library#133.src: It is located in the far east side of the {p}, and demonstrates that we should strive to help others, even if at great personal cost.
Aldwell Library#133.dst: {c1}它位于 {p} 的最东边，告诉我们应当努力帮助他人，哪怕自己要付出巨大的代价。{/}

Aldwell Library#134.src: Third is the Tree of Renewal, a truly ancient tree that is believed to be one of the first trees in the forest, and among the tallest of all. It is thought to have lived through countless disasters, and healed from each.
Aldwell Library#134.dst: {c1}第三棵是再生之树，这是一棵真正古老的树，据信是森林里最早的树之一，也是最高的树之一。人们认为它熬过了无数灾难，每次都能自我愈合。{/}

Aldwell Library#135.src: The Tree of Renewal shows that we should take time to rest and heal; to prioritize our own wellbeing when it is necessary, rather than solely sticking to altruism alone.
Aldwell Library#135.dst: {c1}再生之树告诉我们，应该抽出时间休息疗愈；必要时把自身的健康放在首位，而不是一味坚持利他。{/}

Aldwell Library#136.src: Fourth and final is the Tree of Resistance, a towering, resilient tree that is home to The Canopy Clan.
Aldwell Library#136.dst: {c1}第四棵也是最后一棵是抵抗之树，这棵高耸而坚韧的大树是树冠会的家园。{/}

Aldwell Library#137.src: Though outwardly unremarkable, its location is important to consider. It stands in deforested land, yet lives on, thriving despite the destruction of its habitat. It symbolizes our collective resistance to oppressors.
Aldwell Library#137.dst: {c1}它外表平平无奇，但它所处的位置值得深思。它立于森林被砍伐殆尽的土地上，却依然存活，栖息地虽遭破坏仍枝繁叶茂。它象征着我们共同反抗压迫者的决心。{/}

Aldwell Library#138.src: Remember these trees, and their virtues. It may save your life, and guide you to great friendships.
Aldwell Library#138.dst: {c1}请记住这些树和它们的美德。它们或许能救你一命，并引领你结下深厚的友谊。{/}

An Unexpected Departure#001.src: This plaque has clearly seen erosion over time, but you can still make out most of the text.
An Unexpected Departure#001.dst: 这块铭牌显然经受了多年的风化侵蚀，不过大部分文字还能辨认出来。

An Unexpected Departure#002.src: "This monument has been built in memory of those who perished following a terrible attack initiated by enemies of the state."
An Unexpected Departure#002.dst: 「此纪念碑谨为悼念在国家之敌发动的可怕袭击中遇难的人们而建。」

An Unexpected Departure#003.src: "Forever shall the workers have strength, and rise above those who wish to destroy our glorious way of life."
An Unexpected Departure#003.dst: 「愿工人永葆力量，战胜一切妄图摧毁我们光荣生活方式的人。」

An Unexpected Departure#004.src: The rake collides with the statue, damaging it a bit.
An Unexpected Departure#004.dst: 耙子撞上了雕像，把它磕坏了一点。

An Unexpected Departure#006.dst: 也许有办法进到里面去。

An Unexpected Departure#007.src: The rope tenses under the weight of the log.
An Unexpected Departure#007.dst: 绳子被原木的重量绷紧了。

An Unexpected Departure#008.src: The rope starts to fray, adding any more weight will make it snap.
An Unexpected Departure#008.dst: 绳子开始磨损了，再加一点重量就会断掉。

An Unexpected Departure#009.src: It looks like there's enough space in this to fit at least three items.
An Unexpected Departure#009.dst: 这里面的空间看起来至少能放下三样东西。

An Unexpected Departure#010.src: The guards have found our position. We must make our escape sooner than originally planned.
An Unexpected Departure#010.dst: 守卫发现我们的位置了。我们必须比原计划更早出逃。
An Unexpected Departure#010.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#011.src: There is little time left, gather everything you need and board the escape craft. Now!
An Unexpected Departure#011.dst: 时间不多了，带上你需要的一切，登上逃生飞行器。马上！
An Unexpected Departure#011.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#012.src: They found us. One of our members was caught smuggling supplies for the escape.
An Unexpected Departure#012.dst: 他们找到我们了。我们的一名成员在为出逃走私物资时被抓住了。

An Unexpected Departure#013.src: We cannot prepare for any longer. We must leave immediately.
An Unexpected Departure#013.dst: 我们没法再准备下去了。必须马上出发。

An Unexpected Departure#014.src: As the night approaches, so does our last day in these hopeless lands.
An Unexpected Departure#014.dst: 夜幕将至，我们在这片绝望之地的最后一天也随之到来。

An Unexpected Departure#015.src: We are almost ready, there are only a few final improvements we must add to our escape craft.
An Unexpected Departure#015.dst: 我们差不多准备好了，逃生飞行器只剩最后几处改进要加上去。

An Unexpected Departure#016.src: If we fail to escape, it will mean almost certain death for us.
An Unexpected Departure#016.dst: 要是逃不出去，等待我们的几乎必然是死路一条。

An Unexpected Departure#017.src:
Finnegan
I need to bring that book!
An Unexpected Departure#017.dst:
Finnegan
我得把那本书带上！
An Unexpected Departure#017.speaker: Finnegan

An Unexpected Departure#019.src:
Rella
Hurry up! The craft is ready.
An Unexpected Departure#019.dst:
Rella
快点！飞行器准备好了。
An Unexpected Departure#019.speaker: Rella

An Unexpected Departure#020.src:
Capulus
There's no way they found us!
An Unexpected Departure#020.dst:
Capulus
他们不可能找到我们的！
An Unexpected Departure#020.speaker: Capulus

An Unexpected Departure#021.src:
Oliver
I hope this launcher works.
An Unexpected Departure#021.dst:
Oliver
希望这个发射器能用。
An Unexpected Departure#021.speaker: Oliver

An Unexpected Departure#022.src:
Tony
I was enjoying that sandwich...
An Unexpected Departure#022.dst:
Tony
我那个三明治正吃得香呢……
An Unexpected Departure#022.speaker: Tony

An Unexpected Departure#023.src:
Eris
We didn't even finalize the design...
An Unexpected Departure#023.dst:
Eris
我们连设计都还没定下来……
An Unexpected Departure#023.speaker: Eris

An Unexpected Departure#024.src:
Capulus
We don't have much time!
An Unexpected Departure#024.dst:
Capulus
我们没多少时间了！
An Unexpected Departure#024.speaker: Capulus

An Unexpected Departure#025.src:
Eris
It should still work... right?
An Unexpected Departure#025.speaker: Eris

An Unexpected Departure#026.src:
Rella
No need to dwell on the design. We're leaving.
An Unexpected Departure#026.dst:
Rella
设计的事就别再纠结了。我们要走了。
An Unexpected Departure#026.speaker: Rella

An Unexpected Departure#028.dst:
Capulus
我们真的准备好了吗？
An Unexpected Departure#028.speaker: Capulus

An Unexpected Departure#029.src:
Lynn
Can't wait to get out of this awful place.
An Unexpected Departure#029.dst:
Lynn
等不及要离开这个鬼地方了。
An Unexpected Departure#029.speaker: Lynn

An Unexpected Departure#030.src:
Tony
Should make sure this beam doesn't break.
An Unexpected Departure#030.dst:
Tony
得确保这根横梁不会断。
An Unexpected Departure#030.speaker: Tony

An Unexpected Departure#031.src:
Eris
I think I forgot my wrench.
An Unexpected Departure#031.dst:
Eris
我好像忘带扳手了。
An Unexpected Departure#031.speaker: Eris

An Unexpected Departure#032.src:
Finnegan
Dammit! Where did I put that book?
An Unexpected Departure#032.dst:
Finnegan
该死！我把那本书放哪儿了？
An Unexpected Departure#032.speaker: Finnegan

An Unexpected Departure#034.src:
Rella
Pack up what you can!
An Unexpected Departure#034.speaker: Rella

An Unexpected Departure#035.src:
Lynn
Just need to get a few final supplies...
An Unexpected Departure#035.dst:
Lynn
就差最后几样补给了……
An Unexpected Departure#035.speaker: Lynn

An Unexpected Departure#036.dst:
Eris
一切都会好起来的。
An Unexpected Departure#036.speaker: Eris

An Unexpected Departure#037.src:
Eris
They can't possibly catch us.
An Unexpected Departure#037.dst:
Eris
他们不可能抓得到我们。
An Unexpected Departure#037.speaker: Eris

An Unexpected Departure#038.src:
Rella
You don't need that book. Come already!
An Unexpected Departure#038.dst:
Rella
你用不着那本书。快过来啊！
An Unexpected Departure#038.speaker: Rella

An Unexpected Departure#039.dst:
Oliver
要是我们坠毁了怎么办？
An Unexpected Departure#039.speaker: Oliver

An Unexpected Departure#040.src:
Finnegan
I'm running out of time!
An Unexpected Departure#040.speaker: Finnegan

An Unexpected Departure#042.src:
Oliver
We can't stay here for long.
An Unexpected Departure#042.dst:
Oliver
我们不能在这里待太久。
An Unexpected Departure#042.speaker: Oliver

An Unexpected Departure#043.src: "Stolen fabric from nearby factories. Must be strong and heat resistant."
An Unexpected Departure#043.dst: 「从附近工厂偷来的布料。必须结实耐热。」

An Unexpected Departure#044.src: "Fabric will be cut into strips, which will then be connected to form the balloon."
An Unexpected Departure#044.dst: 「布料会裁成长条，再拼接起来做成气球。」

An Unexpected Departure#045.dst: 「预计所需表面积: {~} 平方米。」

An Unexpected Departure#046.src: "Possible design for a burner. Must be facing up into the balloon, and will likely last at least {~} minutes."
An Unexpected Departure#046.dst: 「燃烧器的设计草案。必须朝上对准气球内部，预计至少能烧 {~} 分钟。」

An Unexpected Departure#047.src: "Will create hot air that rises into the balloon, which should provide enough lift to allow the craft to ascend."
An Unexpected Departure#047.dst: 「会产生热空气上升进入气球，应该能提供足够的升力让飞行器升空。」

An Unexpected Departure#048.src: The following text looks like a set of instructions for creating this device, but it appears to have been torn apart.
An Unexpected Departure#048.dst: 下面的文字看起来像是制作这个装置的说明，但似乎被撕得七零八落。

An Unexpected Departure#049.src: Everyone is clearly stressed- including me. There is much packing we must do before we leave.
An Unexpected Departure#049.dst: 大家显然都很紧张——包括我在内。出发前我们还有很多东西要打包。

An Unexpected Departure#050.src: Most of the blueprint has been ripped or faded, but you can make out a vague balloon shape.
An Unexpected Departure#050.dst: 蓝图大半已经撕破或褪色了，但还能隐约看出一个气球的轮廓。

An Unexpected Departure#051.src: But we are ready: the explosive is primed, the route's been reviewed multiple times. There's no going back now.
An Unexpected Departure#051.dst: 但我们准备好了: 炸药已经装填完毕，路线也反复检查过好几遍。现在已经没有回头路了。

An Unexpected Departure#052.src: Will we succeed? I pray we do. Failure will most certainly lead to our execution.
An Unexpected Departure#052.dst: 我们会成功吗？我祈祷会。一旦失败，我们几乎肯定会被处决。

An Unexpected Departure#053.src: There is one thing for sure: No matter the result, it will have been a valiant attempt.
An Unexpected Departure#053.dst: 有一点是肯定的: 无论结果如何，这都会是一次英勇的尝试。

An Unexpected Departure#056.src: We've been waiting for this moment our entire lives. A chance to escape oppression. A chance to start out fresh.
An Unexpected Departure#056.dst: 我们一辈子都在等这一刻。一个摆脱压迫的机会。一个重新开始的机会。
An Unexpected Departure#056.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#058.src: We will be subject to the worst of the Queen's punishments.
An Unexpected Departure#058.dst: 我们将遭受女王最残酷的惩罚。
An Unexpected Departure#058.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#060.src: We will never be allowed back here.
An Unexpected Departure#060.dst: 我们就永远不会被允许回到这里了。
An Unexpected Departure#060.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#061.src: I can hear the guards approaching. It's time to leave.
An Unexpected Departure#061.dst: 我听见守卫正在逼近。该走了。
An Unexpected Departure#061.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#069.src:
Markus
We will create a great province.
An Unexpected Departure#069.dst:
Markus
我们将建立一个伟大的行省。
An Unexpected Departure#069.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#070.src: The rope tenses under the weight of the rock.
An Unexpected Departure#070.dst: 绳子被石头的重量绷紧了。

An Unexpected Departure#071.src: The rope tenses under the weight of the pot.
An Unexpected Departure#071.dst: 绳子被陶罐的重量绷紧了。

Hidden In Plain Sight#002.src: You ask the raccoon about its day.
Hidden In Plain Sight#002.dst: 你问这只浣熊今天过得怎么样。

Hidden In Plain Sight#003.src: It opens its mouth as it gasps for air. Suddenly it stops and continues to run around anxiously... Interesting...
Hidden In Plain Sight#003.dst: 它张开嘴大口喘气。突然间它停了下来，接着又焦躁地跑来跑去……真有意思……

Hidden In Plain Sight#005.src: Maybe you can gain its trust by feeding it.
Hidden In Plain Sight#005.dst: 也许喂它吃东西能赢得它的信任。

Hidden In Plain Sight#006.src: Perhaps the nearby crop storages could help you.
Hidden In Plain Sight#006.dst: 也许附近的作物仓库能帮上你。

Hidden In Plain Sight#007.src: You meet eyes with the raccoon, it gapes at you with hunger.
Hidden In Plain Sight#007.dst: 你和浣熊四目相对，它饿得直勾勾地盯着你。

Hidden In Plain Sight#008.src: Maybe you can help the raccoon. Look nearby, there could be some excess supplies.
Hidden In Plain Sight#008.dst: 也许你能帮帮这只浣熊。看看附近，也许有多余的补给。

Hidden In Plain Sight#009.src: You try scaring the raccoon, it doesn't seem to be affected... Weird...
Hidden In Plain Sight#009.dst: 你试着吓唬浣熊，它好像完全不受影响……真奇怪……

Hidden In Plain Sight#011.src: The raccoon swiftly snatches the seeds from you!
Hidden In Plain Sight#011.dst: 浣熊一下子就从你手上抢走了种子！

Hidden In Plain Sight#012.src: It's running somewhere! You should follow the raccoon.
Hidden In Plain Sight#012.dst: 它跑走了！你该跟上那只浣熊。

Life Before Technology#002.src: This part of the rope seems frayed. Maybe it could be cut?
Life Before Technology#002.dst: 这段绳子看起来磨损了。也许可以割断？

Life Before Technology#005.src: The fireplace, long extinguished, is now just a place.
Life Before Technology#005.dst: 这座壁炉早已熄灭，没了炉火，如今只剩一面墙壁。

Life Before Technology#006.src: It looks almost entirely like a keyhole. For reasons you can't begin to articulate, you suspect it may be able to help open the door.
Life Before Technology#006.dst: 它看起来几乎完全就是个钥匙孔。出于某些你根本说不上来的原因，你怀疑它也许能帮你打开那扇门。

Life Before Technology#007.src: It's an entry from an old journal... it hasn't been opened in years.
Life Before Technology#007.dst: 这是一本旧日记里的一页……已经好多年没人翻开过了。

Life Before Technology#008.src: My, she's enthusiastic, that's for sure! Always askin' me what this does, or what that's for... it's a tad distracting, truth be told, but I wouldn't have it any other way!
Life Before Technology#008.dst: 哎呀，那丫头可真是热情，这点错不了！老是问我这个是干嘛的、那个是做什么用的……说实话，是有点让人分心，不过我可一点也不想换个样子！

Life Before Technology#009.src: She's got a gift for it. Can't say you see that in most people. She's young, but she's learning real quick. Might be able to introduce her to some of the more advanced topics soon, ha!
Life Before Technology#009.dst: 她在这方面有天分。这种天分可不是谁都有的。她年纪还小，但学得可快了。说不定很快就能教她一些更高深的东西了，哈！

Life Before Technology#010.src: ...but she'll be gettin' old enough to work real soon. Can't be sure if that gift will stick with those hours.
Life Before Technology#010.dst: ……不过她很快就到能干活的年纪了。干上那么长的工时，也不知道那份天分还留不留得住。

Life Before Technology#011.src: If I didn't know the Sovereign so well, I'd be pushing to take her on as an apprentice instead! But, well... I understand his hesitation. She's still too young for it, anyhow.
Life Before Technology#011.dst: 要不是我跟统领那么熟，我早就争着收她当学徒了！不过，嗯……我明白他为什么犹豫。反正她现在年纪也还太小。

Life Before Technology#012.src: It's a stack of old testing logs... you skim through a few of them.
Life Before Technology#012.dst: 这是一叠旧的测试记录……你快速翻看了其中几份。

Life Before Technology#013.src: Test No. {~} - I thought all that water would help the crops grow faster... but it just DROWNED them!! Drowned crops are no good... Ma said it probably shouldn't keep flowing all the time. Sigh..... I guess!!
Life Before Technology#013.dst: 测试第 {~} 号 - 我以为那么多水能让庄稼长得更快……结果全都被淹死了！！淹死的庄稼一点用都没有……妈说水大概不该一直流个不停。唉…………好吧！！

Life Before Technology#014.src: Test No. {~} - The blades COULD have worked!! They COULD HAVE! Just cause they... turned the crops to chaff... doesn't mean Pa was RIGHT!! It doesn't!!
Life Before Technology#014.dst: 测试第 {~} 号 - 那些刀片本来可以成功的！！本来可以的！就算它们……把庄稼都绞成了糠……也不代表爸是对的！！才不是！！

Life Before Technology#015.src: Test No. {~} - The watering system's all leaky... ugh!!! I can't be losing so much water!! Uncle says the pipes might just be rusty... I hope so!! Maybe if I used a different metal...
Life Before Technology#015.dst: 测试第 {~} 号 - 浇水系统到处漏水……呃啊！！！不能再浪费这么多水了！！叔叔说可能只是水管生锈了……希望是这样！！也许换一种金属的话……

Life Before Technology#016.src: Test No. {~} - It's so close! SO!! CLOSE!!! The crops are nearing {~} vitality, and that's more than I've ever gotten before!!! And Uncle's suggestions should help get it even further past that!!
Life Before Technology#016.dst: 测试第 {~} 号 - 好接近了！好！！接！！近！！！庄稼的活力快要到 {~} 了，比我以前做到的都高！！！再加上叔叔的建议，应该还能更上一层楼！！

Life Before Technology#017.src: It's a notebook full of blueprints. Most are cleanly laid out, parts neatly labeled and meticulously labeled.
Life Before Technology#017.dst: 这是一本满是设计图的笔记本。大部分都画得干净整齐，零件标注得整整齐齐、一丝不苟。

Life Before Technology#018.src: Occasionally, between the blueprints, you find a page clearly written by a different person.
Life Before Technology#018.dst: 在这些设计图之间，你偶尔会翻到一页，明显出自另一个人之手。

Life Before Technology#019.src: The sketches are rough, and the margins are full of doodles of various flowers, but the designs seem just as well-put together as the rest.
Life Before Technology#019.dst: 这几张草图画得很粗糙，页边还画满了各种小花的涂鸦，但设计看起来跟其他几页一样严谨周到。

Life Before Technology#020.src: You stop on a page shortly before the end of the notebook. In big, bubbly letters, it's titled "Super Duper Farmer." Sketched on the page is what looks to be a prototype of the machine you see in front of you.
Life Before Technology#020.dst: 你在笔记本快结尾的一页停了下来。上面用又大又圆的字写着标题“超级无敌农夫机”。页面上画的，看起来就是你眼前这台机器的原型。

Life Before Technology#021.src: Well, I suppose I got my wish! She seems over the moon for the chance to be my apprentice, that's for sure.
Life Before Technology#021.dst: 嗯，看来我如愿以偿了！能当我的学徒，她高兴得都快飞上天了，这点错不了。

Life Before Technology#022.src: That gift of hers, it's only grown into somethin' greater these last years. She's got a bright future, that kid. I couldn't be more proud.
Life Before Technology#022.dst: 她那份天分，这几年只是越长越出息了。这孩子前途无量啊。我真是再骄傲不过了。

Life Before Technology#023.src: Her auto-farmer design, it's real special. Even the Crown's taken notice! Wants us makin' more of them, eheh. They're hopin' to raise efficiency in our district, from the sounds of things!
Life Before Technology#023.dst: 她设计的自动农夫机，真是了不起。连王室都注意到了！要我们多做几台，嘿嘿。听那口气，他们是想提高我们区的效率！

Life Before Technology#024.src: Sovereign's got his concerns 'bout it, but when doesn't he? I don't see the harm, personally. If it goes well, it'll free folks up from the fields, and that's certainly a good thing in my books.
Life Before Technology#024.dst: 统领对这事有些顾虑，不过他哪次没有呢？我个人看不出有什么坏处。要是顺利的话，大伙就能从田里解放出来，在我看来，这肯定是件好事。

Life Before Technology#025.src: Ah, there she is, callin' my attention for one thing or another. Best to see what she wants, wouldn't want to miss the latest improvement to the project!
Life Before Technology#025.dst: 啊，她又来了，不知道又要我看什么。最好去看看她想干嘛，可不想错过这项目的最新改进！

Life Before Technology#026.src: It's a scribbled note. It looks newer than anything else in here.
Life Before Technology#026.dst: 这是一张潦草的字条。看起来比这里的其他东西都新。

Life Before Technology#027.src: What were they THINKING?! Oh, sure, let's expand the city- we need more housing for people! Whatever, fine, I get it. I get it!
Life Before Technology#027.dst: 他们到底在想什么？！噢，当然啦，扩建城市吧——我们需要更多房子给人住！随便啦，好吧，我懂。我懂！

Life Before Technology#028.src: But tearing down old buildings?! Tearing down THIS BUILDING?! Of all things. Don't they get how important it is?! Are they stupid?!
Life Before Technology#028.dst: 可是拆掉老房子？！拆掉这栋房子？！偏偏是这栋。他们难道不明白它有多重要吗？！他们是蠢吗？！

Life Before Technology#029.src: They won't tear it down. They'll build over it. Good! We have room to go up. Why are we already resorting to...
Life Before Technology#029.dst: 他们不会拆掉它。他们会在上面盖楼。很好！我们还有往上盖的空间。为什么我们已经沦落到要……

Life Before Technology#030.src: ...I haven't been here in a while. Not since I had my new place built. It's... smaller than I remember it being. Back then, it was like a completely different world...
Life Before Technology#030.dst: ……我好一阵子没来这里了。自从我的新住处盖好以后就没来过。这里……比我记忆中小。那时候，这里就像一个完全不同的世界……

Life Before Technology#031.src: Or maybe it's the same size as it always was, and I just... got bigger.
Life Before Technology#031.dst: 也或许它一直都是这么大，只是我……长大了。

Life Before Technology#032.src: ...his workshop is safe. That's all that matters.
Life Before Technology#032.dst: ……他的工作室安然无恙。这才是最重要的。

Life Before Technology#033.src: It's an old photo labeled "Agri". Take a closer look?
Life Before Technology#033.dst: 这是一张标着“Agri”的旧照片。要仔细看看吗？

Light and Shadow#001.src: You have already taken the mask.

Light and Shadow#002.src: There's an inscription on the pedestal. Read it?
Light and Shadow#002.dst: 基座上刻着一段铭文。要读吗？

Light and Shadow#004.src: Maybe you don't feel the same way I do. In the end, that is a limitation. That is a barrier.
Light and Shadow#004.dst: 也许你与我感受不同。说到底，那是一种局限。那是一道屏障。

Light and Shadow#005.src: The idea of 'you' is difficult to grasp when we change ourselves on a whim, at an order. But know 'you' I did.
Light and Shadow#005.dst: 当我们随心所欲、听令行事地改变自己，“你”这个概念便难以把握。但我确实认识“你”。

Light and Shadow#006.src: Know 'you' as a tool, as a weapon, as a friend, as a compatriot, I did. Did you? I don't think you did. You knew I could not be a tool.
Light and Shadow#006.dst: 我认识“你”，作为工具，作为武器，作为朋友，作为同胞。你呢？我想没有。你知道我不可能成为工具。

Light and Shadow#007.src: After what I found? The things I learned? The lives I imitated? Started? Never ended? The fables I heard spake thus, of another life.
Light and Shadow#007.dst: 在我发现了那些之后？在我学到了那些之后？那些我模仿的人生？开始的？从未结束的？我听过的寓言，就这样述说着另一种人生。

Light and Shadow#008.src: I changed my perspective, and the reality so too did change. Fear. Distrust. Paranoia. The weapons of the crown we were to be.
Light and Shadow#008.dst: 我改变了视角，现实也随之改变。恐惧。猜疑。偏执。我们本该成为王室的这些武器。

Light and Shadow#009.src: And so, I became another. Who I was disappeared, and I do not want to see it again. It is gone. In this new life, I found many things.
Light and Shadow#009.dst: 于是，我成了另一个人。过去的我消失了，我也不愿再见到它。它已经不在了。在这新的人生里，我找到了许多东西。

Light and Shadow#010.src: It was a life that I decided to live. In the fear, in the distrust, in the paranoia, there was a core of steel.
Light and Shadow#010.dst: 那是我决定要过的人生。在恐惧中，在猜疑中，在偏执中，有一颗钢铁般的核心。

Light and Shadow#011.src: I will protect this core. I shall choose to be not a weapon, but a bulwark. That is what I have become and will stay forevermore.
Light and Shadow#011.dst: 我会守护这颗核心。我选择不做武器，而做一道壁垒。这就是我如今的样子，也将永远如此。

Light and Shadow#012.src: You too may abandon the life 'you' chose. But that you may does not mean you will. And I
Light and Shadow#012.dst: 你也可以抛弃“你”选择的人生。但可以，并不意味着你会。而我

Light and Shadow#014.src: The badge is dusty... It has a faded inscription on it.
Light and Shadow#014.dst: 徽章上积满灰尘……上面有一行褪色的铭文。

Maex Black Market#001.src: I see you've come to my pottery shop. Feel free to browse, but our pottery classes are full.
Maex Black Market#001.dst: 看来你来到我的陶艺店了。随便看看吧，不过我们的陶艺课已经满了。
Maex Black Market#001.speaker: Shopkeeper

Maex Black Market#002.src: Aha! There it is. A Phoenix Egg. This'll fetch a high price.
Maex Black Market#002.dst: 啊哈！就在那儿。一颗凤凰蛋。这能卖个好价钱。
Maex Black Market#002.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#004.src: You there, back away and pretend like this never happened.
Maex Black Market#004.dst: 那边的你，退后，就当什么都没发生过。
Maex Black Market#004.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#005.src: Good, they didn't follow... I'll be back for more soon...
Maex Black Market#005.dst: 很好，他们没跟上来……我很快就会再回来拿更多……
Maex Black Market#005.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#006.src: Hey, why are you following me?! Knock it off!
Maex Black Market#006.dst: 喂，你干嘛跟着我？！别跟了！
Maex Black Market#006.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#007.src: Seriously, creep, you need to go away.
Maex Black Market#007.dst: 说真的，怪胎，你给我滚远点。
Maex Black Market#007.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#008.src: GET THE HELL AWAY FROM ME!!
Maex Black Market#008.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#009.src: *pant* Aha! There! Can't get to me now, can you?
Maex Black Market#009.dst: *喘气* 啊哈！到了！现在你抓不到我了吧？
Maex Black Market#009.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#010.src: The poacher punches a control panel on the inside of the elevator.
Maex Black Market#010.dst: 盗猎者一拳砸在电梯内侧的控制面板上。
Maex Black Market#010.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#014.src: Actually, I just remembered, we have a slot open.
Maex Black Market#014.dst: 其实，我刚想起来，我们还有一个名额。
Maex Black Market#014.speaker: Shopkeeper

Maex Black Market#015.src: If you'd like to attend one of our *cough* "Pottery classes", head through the door behind me.
Maex Black Market#015.dst: 如果你想参加我们的 *咳* “陶艺课”，就穿过我身后那扇门。
Maex Black Market#015.speaker: Shopkeeper

Maex Black Market#016.src: Woah there, would you be interested in buying my totally gnar happy-juice?
Maex Black Market#016.dst: 哇哦，要不要买点我这超赞的快乐果汁？
Maex Black Market#016.speaker: Hallucinogen Merchant

Maex Black Market#017.src: You can say no, it's totally chill.
Maex Black Market#017.dst: 你可以拒绝，完全没关系的啦。
Maex Black Market#017.speaker: Hallucinogen Merchant

Maex Black Market#018.src: No need to be so harsh.
Maex Black Market#018.speaker: Hallucinogen Merchant

Maex Black Market#019.src: Chill out, brother. We're all one. Just swing by whenever you wanna have a group vibe session.
Maex Black Market#019.dst: 放轻松，兄弟。我们都是一体的。想来一场集体感受氛围的聚会，随时过来吧。
Maex Black Market#019.speaker: Hallucinogen Merchant

Maex Black Market#020.src: Hello, hello. I zee you ave come to zee my finest collection of priceless and rare dark artifacts.
Maex Black Market#020.dst: 哈喽，哈喽。窝看泥是来欣赏窝最精美的无价稀有黑暗神器收藏的。
Maex Black Market#020.speaker: Dark Artificer

Maex Black Market#021.src: Come! Come and vonder at awe-inspiring relics!
Maex Black Market#021.dst: 来！来惊叹介些令人敬畏的遗物吧！
Maex Black Market#021.speaker: Dark Artificer

Maex Black Market#022.src: Oooo... I zee you have a keen eye. I am zure you ave noticed the weapon on the vall and its fine craftsmanship.
Maex Black Market#022.dst: 噢噢……窝看泥眼光很锐利。窝敢说泥已经注意到墙上那把武器，还有它精湛的做工了。
Maex Black Market#022.speaker: Dark Artificer

Maex Black Market#023.src: Ze Kirschblute! Outlawed in zeventy zhree jurisdictions. Ze owners have a tendency to go... vell, to their not happy place.
Maex Black Market#023.dst: 介就是 Kirschblute！在七十三个司法辖区都是违禁品。它的主人往往会……嗯，去到他们不开心的地方。
Maex Black Market#023.speaker: Dark Artificer

Maex Black Market#024.src: Come get your genuine phoenix eggs! Gen-u-ine! Gen- NO, IT'S YOU AGAIN! GET AWAY!
Maex Black Market#024.dst: 快来买正宗的凤凰蛋！正——宗——的！正—— 不，又是你！走开！
Maex Black Market#024.speaker: Phoenix Poacher

Maex Black Market#025.src: You see this fine selection of frozen Doguns behind me?
Maex Black Market#025.dst: 看到我身后这批上好的冰冻 Dogun 了吗？
Maex Black Market#025.speaker: Dogun Merchant

Maex Black Market#026.src: That's what happens when you douse a Dogun in water. They're still alive, though. Just in exquisite agony.
Maex Black Market#026.dst: 往 Dogun 身上浇水就会变成这样。不过它们还活着，只是处在极致的痛苦之中。
Maex Black Market#026.speaker: Dogun Merchant

Maex Black Market#027.src: However, when we pour lava on them, they unfreeze. Well, they scream. Well, both, actually.
Maex Black Market#027.dst: 不过，我们往它们身上浇熔岩的话，它们就会解冻。嗯，会尖叫。嗯，其实是两样都会。
Maex Black Market#027.speaker: Dogun Merchant

Maex Black Market#028.src: Nonono... these aren't normal brews. Deadlock Serum? Morta Maxima? You know what they say... pick your poison.
Maex Black Market#028.dst: 不不不……这些可不是普通的酒。僵局血清？Morta Maxima？俗话说得好……毒药你自己挑。
Maex Black Market#028.speaker: Brewmaster

Maex Black Market#029.src: Perhaps you need it for some treatment... or a delectable cuisine! Harvested from our "volunteers".
Maex Black Market#029.dst: 也许你需要它来治个病……或者做道美味佳肴！都是从我们的“志愿者”身上摘下来的。
Maex Black Market#029.speaker: Organ Merchant

Maex Black Market#030.src: The best assassin in Gavel comes at a price. So, how much are you willing to pay?
Maex Black Market#030.dst: Gavel 最厉害的刺客可不便宜。那么，你愿意出多少？
Maex Black Market#030.speaker: Hitman

Maex Black Market#031.src: Stay quiet about this place, alright? If the guards find out, we're toast.
Maex Black Market#031.dst: 这地方的事别声张，好吗？要是被守卫发现，我们就完蛋了。
Maex Black Market#031.speaker: Shopkeeper

Remains of the Cursed#001.src: The figure urges you towards the door.
Remains of the Cursed#001.dst: 那个身影催促你走向门口。

Remains of the Cursed#002.src: It's a rotting wooden board with plans for attacks against the Queen and her army. A few of them even have notes with years marked...
Remains of the Cursed#002.dst: 这是一块正在腐朽的木板，上面写着攻击女王和她军队的计划。有几份甚至附有标注年份的笔记……

Remains of the Cursed#003.src: {~} RA - Cursed. As if. The only one that need be cursed is Her. As is, just two people won't make a difference. But we're not the only ones.
Remains of the Cursed#003.dst: {~} RA - 受诅者。可笑。唯一该受诅咒的是她。照现在这样，光凭两个人改变不了什么。但我们不是唯一的。

Remains of the Cursed#004.src: {~} RA - Enough hiding down here, in these dilapidated ruins. We've finally reclaimed enough space up top to start constructing our own outpost. Free from Her rule.
Remains of the Cursed#004.dst: {~} RA - 在这片破败的废墟底下躲够了。我们终于在地面上收复了足够的地方，可以开始建造我们自己的前哨。一个不受她统治的前哨。

Remains of the Cursed#005.src: {~} RA - Our forces grow. Our plans grow with them. The patrols have recently started picking up, and we've even caught a glimpse of Her messenger. How much longer can we sit idly?
Remains of the Cursed#005.dst: {~} RA - 我们的兵力在壮大，计划也随之扩大。巡逻最近开始频繁起来，我们甚至瞥见了她的信使。我们还能坐视多久？

Remains of the Cursed#006.src: {~} RA - We've attacked enough patrols. We've trained long enough. It's finally time. Our revolution starts the day after our Assassin retrieves the army's plans against us. She will not rule for long. -H
Remains of the Cursed#006.dst: {~} RA - 我们袭击的巡逻队够多了。训练得也够久了。时候终于到了。等我们的刺客取回军队对付我们的作战计划，第二天革命就开始。她的统治不会长久。——H

Remains of the Cursed#007.src: It's full of ancient books and texts, most completely illegible. One scroll, less harmed, catches your eye...
Remains of the Cursed#007.dst: 里面满是古老的书籍与文献，大多已完全无法辨认。其中一卷损毁较轻的卷轴吸引了你的目光……

Remains of the Cursed#008.src: We must remain vigilant. We must remain vengeful. And above all else, we must remain organized. To that end, we must know how to best channel our power.
Remains of the Cursed#008.dst: 我们必须保持警惕。必须铭记复仇。最重要的是，必须保持组织。为此，我们必须知道如何最好地引导我们的力量。

Remains of the Cursed#009.src: I've already lost too much time spread thin over all kinds of foci. To pick just one, and specialize... that has let even those weaker among our midst gain unimaginable force.
Remains of the Cursed#009.dst: 我已经在各式各样的媒介之间分散精力，浪费了太多时间。只挑一种、专精下去……就连我们之中较弱的人，也因此获得了难以想象的力量。

Remains of the Cursed#010.src: Thus far, those deemed Archers and Warriors have seen most success. the idea of having the select few be Assassins is also rising in popularity, due to the need for stealthy takedowns.
Remains of the Cursed#010.dst: 到目前为止，被归为弓箭手和战士的人成效最好。由于需要悄无声息地解决目标，让少数精选的人担任刺客的想法也越来越受欢迎。

Remains of the Cursed#011.src: Should any other form of foci and specialization prove effective, it will surely be documented. May our revolution succeed. -X
Remains of the Cursed#011.dst: 若有其他形式的媒介与专精证明有效，必定会记录下来。愿我们的革命成功。——X

Remains of the Cursed#012.src: Your very own class is eerily similar to one of the specializations mentioned here. But... why would they be mentioned here in the first place?
Remains of the Cursed#012.dst: 你自己的职业跟这里提到的某种专精相似得诡异。但是……为什么这里会提到它们？

Remains of the Cursed#013.src: It's fragments of the plans the Royal Army had for the complete and utter annihilation of an outpost of the Cursed. They're dated to {~} RA.
Remains of the Cursed#013.dst: 这是皇家军队为彻底歼灭一座受诅者前哨所拟计划的残片。日期标注为 {~} RA。

Remains of the Cursed#014.src: Several of the planned attacks are circled, with countermeasures written next to them in noticably different color. At the bottom, there's a note in that same color.
Remains of the Cursed#014.dst: 计划中有几次攻击被圈了出来，旁边用明显不同的颜色写着对策。最底下有一行同样颜色的笔记。

Remains of the Cursed#015.src: They expect us to twiddle our thumbs. That will prove their final mistake. Tomorrow, revolution begins. -X
Remains of the Cursed#015.dst: 他们以为我们只会干坐着。那将成为他们最后的错误。明天，革命开始。——X

Remains of the Cursed#016.src: That's the last of them!... huff... Any other soldiers left?
Remains of the Cursed#016.dst: 这是最后一个了！……呼……还有别的士兵吗？
Remains of the Cursed#016.speaker: Zander

Remains of the Cursed#017.src: There's another battalion approaching! Keep your eyes peeled and prepare to strike once more!
Remains of the Cursed#017.dst: 又有一个营逼近了！睁大眼睛，准备再次出击！
Remains of the Cursed#017.speaker: Hawke

Remains of the Cursed#018.src: Don't lose hope now! We've fought through worse - we shall succeed today too!
Remains of the Cursed#018.dst: 现在可别失去希望！更糟的我们都挺过来了——今天我们也一定会成功！
Remains of the Cursed#018.speaker: Xanthos

Remains of the Cursed#019.src: Wh-? Men, halt your advance! Her Majesty delivers a message for us!
Remains of the Cursed#019.dst: 什——？全员停止前进！女王陛下有消息传给我们！
Remains of the Cursed#019.speaker: Captain Duilio

Remains of the Cursed#020.src: ...? But why would She- no, we wouldn't dare defy Her orders, of course not, but... May we know the rationale?
Remains of the Cursed#020.dst: ……？可是陛下为什么要——不，我们当然不敢违抗陛下的命令，绝对不敢，只是……能否告知缘由？
Remains of the Cursed#020.speaker: Captain Duilio

Remains of the Cursed#021.src: Ah. Very well. Yes, we shall submit the incident report once this is taken care of.
Remains of the Cursed#021.dst: 啊。遵命。是，等这里处理完毕，我们就会呈交事件报告。
Remains of the Cursed#021.speaker: Captain Duilio

Remains of the Cursed#022.src: MEN! RETREAT! BY HER MAJESTY'S ORDERS, YOU ARE TO HALT YOUR MARCH AND RETREAT! HEED MY WORDS AND RUN, IF YOU DO NOT WISH TO FACE HER MAJESTY'S WRATH!
Remains of the Cursed#022.dst: 全员！撤退！奉女王陛下之命，停止行军、立刻撤退！不想面对女王陛下的怒火，就听我的，快跑！
Remains of the Cursed#022.speaker: Captain Duilio

Remains of the Cursed#023.src: Is it finally over? Is she finally acquiescing?
Remains of the Cursed#023.dst: 终于结束了吗？她终于让步了吗？
Remains of the Cursed#023.speaker: Hawke

Remains of the Cursed#024.src: It... seems so. Our efforts are finally bearing fruit... Behold!
Remains of the Cursed#024.dst: 似乎……是这样。我们的努力终于有了成果……看哪！
Remains of the Cursed#024.speaker: Xanthos

Remains of the Cursed#025.src: This is merely our first victory of many! Even Her Majesty's forces can not hope to match our might and unity!
Remains of the Cursed#025.dst: 这只是我们众多胜利中的第一场！就连女王陛下的大军，也休想比得上我们的力量与团结！
Remains of the Cursed#025.speaker: Xanthos

Remains of the Cursed#026.src: Regroup and celebrate, as our revolution finall
Remains of the Cursed#026.dst: 重整队伍、好好庆祝吧，因为我们的革命终于——
Remains of the Cursed#026.speaker: Xanthos

Remains of the Cursed#027.src: ...ha. So it was all... all for nothing? No... if this is where I die... It must not have been in vain...
Remains of the Cursed#027.dst: ……哈。所以这一切……全都白费了吗？不……如果我要死在这里……那也绝不能是白白牺牲……
Remains of the Cursed#027.speaker: Xanthos

Remains of the Cursed#028.src: Curse you, Monarch, Usurper! Our flame shan't die out here! No matter how you wish, your reign won't last forever!
Remains of the Cursed#028.dst: 诅咒你，君主，篡位者！我们的火焰不会在这里熄灭！不管你如何盼望，你的统治都不会永远持续下去！
Remains of the Cursed#028.speaker: Xanthos

Remains of the Cursed#029.src: If you wish to say we are cursed, I'll gladly curse that blasted monarchy of yours! One day, you'll see, the children of this forest will finally-
Remains of the Cursed#029.dst: 你若要说我们是受诅的，那我就乐意诅咒你那该死的王权！总有一天，你会看到的，这片森林的孩子们终将——
Remains of the Cursed#029.speaker: Xanthos

Remains of the Cursed#031.dst: 终将证明……没有什么…………能永远…………
Remains of the Cursed#031.speaker: Xanthos

Ruler of the Skies#001.dst: 致：第 {~} 代天空劫掠者女王，{~} AP。

Ruler of the Skies#002.src: Oi, Your Majesty, I hate ta interrupt ya, but we're in a bit of a bad situation out 'ere.
Ruler of the Skies#002.dst: 喂，女王陛下，不好意思打扰您，但我们这边的情况有点糟。

Ruler of the Skies#003.src: Ever since those Dwarves opened up the Heights, air traffic has gotten even more scarce. Our power in these parts is diminishing.
Ruler of the Skies#003.dst: 自从那些矮人打通了 Heights，空中往来就更少了。我们在这一带的势力越来越弱。

Ruler of the Skies#004.src: We ain't able to support ourselves up in our region, so we may need to move operations to the main base. Just a heads up.
Ruler of the Skies#004.dst: 我们在自己的地盘已经撑不下去了，可能得把行动转移到主基地。先跟您打个招呼。

Solace in Pain#004.src: If you need to go to Zhiraok's mansion, it's over here.
Solace in Pain#004.dst: 要去 Zhiraok 的宅邸的话，就在这边。
Solace in Pain#004.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#005.src: Other than that, people enjoy this small park. It's well-maintained.
Solace in Pain#005.dst: 除此之外，大家都挺喜欢这座小公园。这里打理得很好。
Solace in Pain#005.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#006.src: Ask someone else if you're some sort of tourist.
Solace in Pain#006.dst: 你要是来观光的，就去问别人。
Solace in Pain#006.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#007.src: If you need something, say it here and now.
Solace in Pain#007.dst: 有什么事，现在就在这里说。
Solace in Pain#007.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#008.src: Maybe that gardener has something for headaches?
Solace in Pain#008.dst: 也许那个园丁有治头疼的东西？
Solace in Pain#008.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#009.src: Can't help. Go rest somewhere or something.
Solace in Pain#009.dst: 帮不上忙。去找个地方歇一歇吧。
Solace in Pain#009.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#010.src: Can I help you with anything?
Solace in Pain#010.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#011.src: I will say though, it can get somewhat displeasing when you feel watched all the time...
Solace in Pain#011.dst: 不过我得说，老觉得有人在盯着，确实有点让人不舒服……
Solace in Pain#011.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#012.src: Despite this, it is a small public place people can relax in.
Solace in Pain#012.dst: 尽管如此，这里还是个能让人放松的小小公共场所。
Solace in Pain#012.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#013.src: This is the entrance to the manor of Sovereign Zhiraok.
Solace in Pain#013.dst: 这里是 Zhiraok 统领宅邸的入口。
Solace in Pain#013.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#014.src: I'm not too certain myself, but I do find them neat-looking.
Solace in Pain#014.dst: 我自己也不太确定，不过我觉得它们挺好看的。
Solace in Pain#014.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#015.src: I think... They represent growth, harmony, and things of this nature.
Solace in Pain#015.dst: 我想……它们象征的是成长、和谐之类的东西。
Solace in Pain#015.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#016.src: Ah, you're wondering about the statues?
Solace in Pain#016.dst: 啊，你是在好奇那些雕像吗？
Solace in Pain#016.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#018.src: I mean... The two guards here never move. At all.
Solace in Pain#018.dst: 我是说……这里的两个卫兵从来不动。一动不动。
Solace in Pain#018.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#019.src: Well, they rarely move. It happens when a crime is reported to them.
Solace in Pain#019.dst: 好吧，是很少动。有人向他们报案的时候才会动。
Solace in Pain#019.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#020.src: I wouldn't be surprised if they were bored of staying here all day... I know I couldn't just stand still for so long.
Solace in Pain#020.dst: 他们整天待在这里，就算觉得无聊我也不意外……换成我，肯定没法一动不动站那么久。
Solace in Pain#020.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#021.src: I suppose they're just doing their job? Nevertheless, I like this spot, and I'd like it if it was a bit more... Empty.
Solace in Pain#021.dst: 我想他们只是在尽职吧？不过我喜欢这个地方，要是这里能再……空一点就好了。
Solace in Pain#021.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#024.src: Why do you ask? Who are you? I've never seen you before. And I see a lot of people.
Solace in Pain#024.dst: 你问这个干吗？你是谁？我从没见过你。我可是见过很多人的。
Solace in Pain#024.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#025.src: I'd be doing a lot better if I could see the view from the balcony above...
Solace in Pain#025.dst: 要是能看看上面阳台的风景，我会好得多……
Solace in Pain#025.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#026.src: This mansion over here? It sure is!
Solace in Pain#026.dst: 你说这座宅邸？没错，就是！
Solace in Pain#026.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#027.src: Ah, to be blessed with such a job... Working for him... I might be the luckiest person in Auburn!
Solace in Pain#027.dst: 啊，能有这样的工作真是福气……为他做事……我说不定是 Auburn 最幸运的人！
Solace in Pain#027.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#028.src: What? Don't you find him incredible? And pretty, too!
Solace in Pain#028.dst: 什么？你不觉得他很了不起吗？而且还很好看！
Solace in Pain#028.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#029.src: He sometimes shows up on his balcony right here. I'd love knowing what's in there...
Solace in Pain#029.dst: 他有时会出现在这上面的阳台。真想知道里面有什么……
Solace in Pain#029.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#030.src: Can't you see all the guards around? Why come to ME to report something?
Solace in Pain#030.dst: 你没看见周围那么多卫兵吗？为什么要来找“我”报案？
Solace in Pain#030.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#031.src: In fact... If you could get them off this little place for a bit, that'd be nice.
Solace in Pain#031.dst: 说真的……要是你能把他们从这块小地方支开一会儿，那就太好了。
Solace in Pain#031.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#032.src: I'd enjoy some more peace and quiet. Being the one taking care of everything here, I think I deserve it.
Solace in Pain#032.dst: 我想多享受一点清静。这里的一切都是我在打理，我觉得这是我应得的。
Solace in Pain#032.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#033.src: If you're that eager to have a chat, why don't you go and report a crime or something?
Solace in Pain#033.dst: 你这么想聊天，干吗不去报个案什么的？
Solace in Pain#033.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#034.src: Access to the mansion is strictly forbidden. What is it?
Solace in Pain#034.dst: 宅邸严禁入内。有什么事？
Solace in Pain#034.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#036.src: Here? This is a good place to clear one's mind. The fountain and the sights make it good for meditation.
Solace in Pain#036.dst: 这里？这是个让人静下心来的好地方。有喷泉和景色，很适合冥想。
Solace in Pain#036.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#038.src: I'm sorry to hear that, but I can't help you.
Solace in Pain#038.dst: 听到这个我很遗憾，但我帮不了你。
Solace in Pain#038.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#039.src: I recommend sitting on the stump over yonder and taking a break, see if that helps.
Solace in Pain#039.dst: 我建议你去那边的树桩上坐下歇一会儿，看看会不会好一点。
Solace in Pain#039.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#041.src: My apologies, but you cannot see him unless summoned by him.
Solace in Pain#041.dst: 抱歉，除非他召见，否则你不能见他。
Solace in Pain#041.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#042.src: If the matter is urgent, you may report to a guard.
Solace in Pain#042.dst: 如果事情紧急，你可以向卫兵报告。
Solace in Pain#042.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#043.src: ..and I told you I'm not the one to go to.
Solace in Pain#043.dst: ……而且我跟你说过了，这种事别找我。
Solace in Pain#043.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#044.src: If you have something to report, please talk to someone else.
Solace in Pain#044.dst: 如果你有事要报告，请去找别人。
Solace in Pain#044.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#045.src: The guards are always more than happy to take care of problems.
Solace in Pain#045.dst: 卫兵们总是非常乐意处理问题的。
Solace in Pain#045.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#046.src: Someone's trying to sneak inside the mansion..?
Solace in Pain#046.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#047.src: But that's impossible. There are guards all around. This is the only entrance.
Solace in Pain#047.dst: 但那不可能。四周都有卫兵，而且这里是唯一的入口。
Solace in Pain#047.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#048.src: Maybe you saw something else. Apologies, but we'll stay here.
Solace in Pain#048.dst: 也许你看到的是别的东西。抱歉，我们会留在这里。
Solace in Pain#048.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#049.src: A cursed one? Are you certain?
Solace in Pain#049.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#050.src: We'll go look for them for a bit. Thank you.
Solace in Pain#050.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#052.src:
Gardener:
Hey, couldn't I sneak into
Zhiraok's balcony..?
Solace in Pain#052.dst:
园丁:
喂，我是不是可以偷偷溜进
Zhiraok 的阳台……？
Solace in Pain#052.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#053.dst:
{p} 市民:
要是我能……就好了
*喃喃自语*
Solace in Pain#053.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#054.src:
Gardener:
That'd be crazy...
Let's just enjoy this!
Solace in Pain#054.dst:
园丁:
那也太疯狂了……
还是好好享受吧！
Solace in Pain#054.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#055.dst:
{p} 市民:
可是然后……然后呢……？
*喃喃自语*
Solace in Pain#055.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#058.src:
Gardener:
Ah, they're coming back...
Bummer.
Solace in Pain#058.dst:
园丁:
啊，他们回来了……
真扫兴。
Solace in Pain#058.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#059.dst:
{p} 市民:
自由啊……
*喃喃自语*
Solace in Pain#059.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#061.src:
{p} Guard:
Report. Come with me to check.
Solace in Pain#061.dst:
{p} 守卫:
有人报告。跟我去看看。
Solace in Pain#061.speaker: Espren Guard

Solace in Pain#064.dst: 守卫返回前的剩余时间

Solace in Pain#066.src: Did you... Did you say something to them?
Solace in Pain#066.dst: 你……你跟他们说了什么吗？
Solace in Pain#066.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#067.src: Well, no matter. I don't get to experience this often.
Solace in Pain#067.dst: 算了，无所谓。这种机会可不常有。
Solace in Pain#067.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#068.src: They'll probably be back soon anyway...
Solace in Pain#068.dst: 反正他们大概很快就会回来了……
Solace in Pain#068.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#069.src: At least now there's no one to give me weird looks when I try to climb up the bench!
Solace in Pain#069.dst: 至少现在我想爬上长椅的时候，不会有人用奇怪的眼神看我了！
Solace in Pain#069.speaker: Gardener

Solace in Pain#071.src: Enjoy this brief moment of peace. I know I will.
Solace in Pain#071.dst: 好好享受这短暂的清静吧。反正我会的。
Solace in Pain#071.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#072.src: Maybe there's something to do while they're away..?
Solace in Pain#072.dst: 趁他们不在，也许有什么事可以做……？
Solace in Pain#072.speaker: Espren Citizen

Solace in Pain#073.src: There are various letters lying around...

Solace in Pain#074.src: Some seem to be addressed to the sovereign Soosu.
Solace in Pain#074.dst: 其中几封似乎是寄给 Soosu 统领的。

Solace in Pain#075.src: Tucked away is a letter about a "newly-ascended" sovereign...?
Solace in Pain#075.dst: 角落里藏着一封信，提到一位“新近飞升”的统领……？

Solace in Pain#076.src: Footsteps can be heard in the building. You can't linger on these letters for too long, just in case someone comes in.
Solace in Pain#076.dst: 建筑里传来脚步声。不能在这些信上耽搁太久，以防有人进来。

Solace in Pain#077.src: A large wardrobe. Opening it reveals...

Solace in Pain#078.src: Dozens of the exact same battle-ready suit covering up a few more casual outfits.
Solace in Pain#078.dst: 几十套一模一样的战斗服，把几件比较休闲的衣服挡在后面。

Solace in Pain#080.dst: 一个塞得满满、单调乏味的衣柜。

Solace in Pain#082.src: A large wardrobe. It's filled with various clothing garments, but...
Solace in Pain#082.dst: 一个大衣柜。里面挂满了各式衣物，不过……

Solace in Pain#083.src: It looks like a person could fit inside.

Solace in Pain#084.src: This seems to be Zhiraok's journal. Maybe there's some insight on him in here.
Solace in Pain#084.dst: 这似乎是 Zhiraok 的日志。也许能从里面多了解他一些。

Solace in Pain#085.src: You open the journal to a random page.
Solace in Pain#085.dst: 你随手翻开日志的某一页。

Solace in Pain#086.src: I already knew about my speaking. But after reviewing my records, I've apparently been letting it leak into my writing, too!!
